recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-18382, and changing back toward the 2018 intermediate URL would conflict with the later FHIR-34212 cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-18382 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 fhir-i change request for FHIR-core extensibility examples. It requested changing the participation-agreement extension reference from http://example.org/phr/documents/fhir/extensions#participation-agreement to a non-fragment URL, and the resolution said to fix the URL in the example as suggested.
initial_application: Commit 660e666553f973b570e696345660821a94049e30 applied GF#18382 by changing source/extensibility-examples.html so the Patient profile's extension slice referenced a StructureDefinition-style participation-agreement URL instead of the legacy fragment URL.
additional_context: source/extensibility-examples.html is current build-scope source via source/hierarchy.xml and related core links. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-34212 corrected the same example family so the instance and referencing profile use the same canonical URL as the extension definition, now http://example.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/participation-agreement. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
